description: Defines a class SymbolSet that encapsulates character encoding ranges for various character sets such as Latin-1, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Emoticons, and Dingbats. The class includes static properties for predefined ranges and a constructor to initialize custom sets.

classes.name: SymbolSet
classes.description: Represents a set of character encoding ranges, providing predefined character sets and the ability to create custom sets.

methods.name: SymbolSet
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the symbol set with a collection of ranges, throwing an exception if the input is null.
